name: OWASP Top 10 for MCP
disclaimer: Independent academic implementation. OWASP MCP Top 10 is a living security reference, not a certification.

controls.title: Token Mismanagement & Secret Exposure
controls.description: Secrets or access tokens may be exposed through code, configuration, memory, or protocol logs.
controls.verification_guidance: Inspect credential storage, token lifetime, logs, and secret redaction.

controls.title: Privilege Escalation via Scope Creep
controls.description: Agent or tool permissions may exceed the minimum required scope or expand without review.
controls.verification_guidance: Review tool permissions, scope boundaries, and authorization checks.

controls.title: Tool Poisoning
controls.description: Untrusted tools, metadata, or tool responses may manipulate an agent's decisions.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify tool provenance, integrity, and handling of untrusted tool output.

controls.title: Software Supply Chain Attacks & Dependency Tampering
controls.description: Compromised packages or dependencies can alter MCP server and tool behavior.
controls.verification_guidance: Review dependency pinning, provenance, integrity checks, and vulnerable packages.

controls.title: Command Injection & Execution
controls.description: Untrusted content may reach shell, code execution, or other command interpreters.
controls.verification_guidance: Trace untrusted values to command execution and require strict validation and least privilege.

controls.title: Prompt Injection via Contextual Payloads
controls.description: Instructions embedded in user or external content may influence agent behavior.
controls.verification_guidance: Test untrusted tool and retrieved content boundaries, instruction hierarchy, and injection mitigations.

controls.title: Insufficient Authentication & Authorization
controls.description: Weak identity verification or access checks can expose MCP servers, tools, or data.
controls.verification_guidance: Test authentication, per-tool authorization, identity propagation, and access boundaries.

controls.title: Lack of Audit and Telemetry
controls.description: Missing security-relevant event records can obstruct detection and incident response.
controls.verification_guidance: Verify protected audit records for tool calls, identity, context changes, and security events.

controls.title: Shadow MCP Servers
controls.description: Unmanaged MCP server deployments can evade inventory, security policy, and monitoring.
controls.verification_guidance: Inventory deployed servers and inspect deployment configuration, exposure, and ownership.

controls.title: Context Injection & Over-Sharing
controls.description: Shared or persistent context can leak data across users, tasks, or agents.
controls.verification_guidance: Check session and tenant isolation, context lifetime, and access controls on retrieved data.
